utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Morning, everyone. Thursday the twenty-first. Can you all hear me, or am I doing the Teams mime again?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yeah, you're fine. Sorry, only just sat down. Traffic on the ring road was ridiculous.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Same queue, probably. Plenty of time to admire the back of a bus.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: At least your bus probably wasn't as hot as the portakabin. The heating in there, honestly. Tropical. Just moaning, before anyone puts my name against it.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: There's a birthday cake in the office, if that improves matters.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Depends whether it's survived being in that heat.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, before this becomes the cake meeting. Couple of closed bits first.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Already swapped the filter on the palletiser yesterday. That's done, not another job for today.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Yep, that's the one I thought was still showing. Done, understood.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And tested the Line 1 Hydraulic Power Unit yesterday and it's all fine now. That one's closed as well.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Lovely. No outstanding bit hanging off that, then.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Quality side, finished the repair on the CT1 last night. Nothing left on that repair.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good, another closed one.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Um, just an observation from nights: noticed the GT1 Fuel Gas Valve was running a bit warm, but it settled down. Not raising a job off that.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, so, settled rather than still climbing. Understood.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Similar sort of thing, I heard a slight rattle from the Injection Moulding Line 1. Nothing to action yet, just mentioning what I heard.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Both observations, neither going down as a new action.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: And the other one hasn't moved: can't get to the compressor one until production gives us a window.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, there's no window available on the schedule. Still blocked, not a booked job.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right. We're not agreeing to get that done today when there's no access.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: On what I can take, I'll replace the seals on the GT2 water valve by end of day. Not an emergency but don't let it slip, that's how I'm treating it.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Just the seals on the GT2 water valve, yeah? Not changing the whole valve?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yeah, just the seals. I'll do the replacement, not just stick it on somebody else's list.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Thanks, Fiona. Yours, by end of day. Not an emergency, but it does need to stay on track.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yep, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: And Fiona Doyle, can you chase the purchase order for the HV board tomorrow, if you've got a spare minute?

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Yes, I'll chase the purchase order for the HV board tomorrow, if I've got a spare minute.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Cheers. Definitely the spare-minute one, not something to bump the seals for.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: Got you. Different urgency.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Grace Liu, can you take vibration readings on the Water Booster Pump by Wednesday? It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Sorry, no, I can't take that. I haven't got the capacity to commit to the readings.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, thanks for being straight. Marcus, can I hand that to you instead? Vibration readings on the Water Booster Pump, by Wednesday. It's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, I'll take it from Grace Liu. I'll take vibration readings on the Water Booster Pump by Wednesday, and I've got that it's urgent.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: Sorry, talking over you—readings only on that one, we're not agreeing an overhaul or anything?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Readings only, yeah. That's what I'm taking.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Exactly. Keep the scope as it is.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: While I'm on, I'll run a function test on the guard switch on two tomorrow. Low priority, that one.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: That's the routine function test, isn't it? Not saying we've got a failed guard in use?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yeah, routine function test. I'm not reporting a failure.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay, Marc, the guard switch on two is yours for tomorrow, low priority.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Yep, agreed.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: We've also got to do the pre-use checks on the forklifts by Wednesday. Fairly important. Anyone able to take that?

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: It does need someone against it. I'm not volunteering, though; I can't take it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Anyone else for the forklifts? Don't want to mistake silence for a yes.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Not me, sorry. Can't commit to those checks.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: I can't add that one either.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, pre-use checks on the forklifts remain unallocated. Still needed by Wednesday, fairly important, but nobody's taken them.

utterances.speaker: Aisha Begum
utterances.text: There's also grease and check the bearings on the CV01. Next Tuesday, normal priority. Needs doing, but I'm raising it, not taking it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Any takers for the CV01 bearings?

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: No room for that on mine, sorry.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Nor mine. I know it sounds like my sort of job, but I can't accept it.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Okay. Grease and check the bearings on the CV01 stays without an owner. Next Tuesday, normal priority.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: That's clear. A couple of gaps, rather than pretending everything's covered.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Yep. And just keeping the two priorities separate, Marcus has the urgent Water Booster Pump readings; Marc has the low-priority guard switch on two test. Same person, before Teams gets confused.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Both me, unfortunately for me. Pump by Wednesday, guard test tomorrow. Agreed.

utterances.speaker: Fiona Doyle
utterances.text: And mine's seals on the GT2 water valve by end of day, then the purchase order for the HV board tomorrow if I've got a spare minute. Clear.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Good. Nobody against the forklifts or the CV01. Those are gaps, not quiet assignments to anyone.

utterances.speaker: Grace Liu
utterances.text: Yes, that's the distinction. No assumed volunteers.

utterances.speaker: Hannah Price
utterances.text: Much less ambiguity over who's interested in the cake, I suspect.

utterances.speaker: Tomasz Nowak
utterances.text: Normal priority. Unless it's chocolate.

utterances.speaker: Sarah Okafor
utterances.text: Right, that's us. No more jobs hidden in the banter. Thanks, everyone.

utterances.speaker: Marcus Hale
utterances.text: Cheers, all.
